title: Query, key and value
note: text = subtitles; say = the same sentences spelled for the voice. Numbers from films/qkv_data.json (block 24, head 2, last prompt position).

blocks.text: Emma's question is now a row of 100 tokens. The last one sits at the very end, where the answer is about to begin. Before the model writes a word, this position has to find out which earlier tokens matter.
blocks.say: Emma's question is now a row of one hundred tokens. The last one sits at the very end, where the answer is about to begin. Before the model writes a word, this position has to find out which earlier tokens matter.

blocks.text: Attention gives every token three new vectors. A query: what am I looking for? A key: what do I contain? And a value: what I will pass on, if I am chosen.
blocks.say: Attention gives every token three new vectors. A query: what am I looking for? A key: what do I contain? And a value: what I will pass on, if I am chosen.

blocks.text: All three are made from the token's own vector, by three learned matrices. In block 24, head 2, each one is 64 numbers long.
blocks.say: All three are made from the token's own vector, by three learned matrices. In block twenty-four, head two, each one is sixty-four numbers long.

blocks.text: Now the last position sends out its query, to every key so far, its own included. Multiply query and key, number by number, and add it all up. That is a dot product: one score per token. When the two point the same way, the score is high.
blocks.say: Now the last position sends out its query, to every key so far, its own included. Multiply query and key, number by number, and add it all up. That is a dot product: one score per token. When the two point the same way, the score is high.

blocks.text: Divided by 8, the square root of 64, the scores come out like this. Manchester, in Emma's question: 7.8. The Manchester in the system prompt: 5.4. Stores: 4.5. And battery, only 1.4. This head is looking for a place, not an item.
blocks.say: Divided by eight, the square root of sixty-four, the scores come out like this. Manchester, in Emma's question: seven point eight. The Manchester in the system prompt: five point four. Stores: four point five. And battery, only one point four. This head is looking for a place, not an item.

blocks.text: Softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to one. Every lead is magnified: 2.4 points ahead becomes ten times the weight. Manchester now takes 65 percent. The other 99 positions share the rest.
blocks.say: Softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to one. Every lead is magnified: two point four points ahead becomes ten times the weight. Manchester now takes sixty-five percent. The other ninety-nine positions share the rest.

blocks.text: Then the values. Each one steps forward, scaled by its weight. Manchester, at almost full strength. The rest, faint. Added together, they make one new vector of 64 numbers.
blocks.say: Then the values. Each one steps forward, scaled by its weight. Manchester, at almost full strength. The rest, faint. Added together, they make one new vector of sixty-four numbers.

blocks.text: That is what this head passes up: mostly, what Manchester means in this sentence. The query asks, the keys answer, and the values are mixed by how well they matched. Fourteen heads do this side by side, in each of 24 blocks.
blocks.say: That is what this head passes up: mostly, what Manchester means in this sentence. The query asks, the keys answer, and the values are mixed by how well they matched. Fourteen heads do this side by side, in each of twenty-four blocks.
